name: fem loads: an 80 × 40 × 10 steel plate with a 12 mm hole (sketch + extrude: a true cylindrical hole)
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await m.actions.closeProject({ force: true }); await m.actions.newDocument('part', { blank: true }); await sleep(300); const { itemsToSketch } = await import('/src/cad/cad2d-import.js'); const { createFeature } = await import('/src/cad/features.js'); m.actions.change('op.feature', (p) => { const part = p.parts.find((x) => x.id === p.active.id); const { sketch } = itemsToSketch([{ kind: 'line', a: [0, 0], b: [80, 0] }, { kind: 'line', a: [80, 0], b: [80, 40] }, { kind: 'line', a: [80, 40], b: [0, 40] }, { kind: 'line', a: [0, 40], b: [0, 0] }, { kind: 'circle', c: [20, 20], r: 6 }]); const sk = createFeature(part, 'sketch', { plane: { kind: 'std', name: 'top' }, ...sketch }); part.features.push(sk, createFeature(part, 'extrude', { sketch: sk.id, depth: 10 })); }); await sleep(1200); await m.run('simulation'); await sleep(300); return JSON.stringify({ mode: m.state.editing?.mode, cyl: m.state.partEntry.faces.filter((f) => /CYL/.test(f.geomType)).length }); })()

name: fem loads: the kinds are offered; bearing on the hole with the far end fixed — the plate bends toward it
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const faces = m.state.partEntry.faces; const all = faces.map((f, index) => ({ f, index })); const mk = (x, kind) => ({ index: x.index, faceId: x.f.hashCode, type: x.f.geomType, ...(kind ? { kind } : {}) }); const planes = all.filter((x) => x.f.geomType === 'PLANE'); const hole = all.find((x) => /CYL/.test(x.f.geomType)); const at = (c, v) => planes.find((x) => Math.abs(x.f.center[c] - v) < 1e-6); const run = async () => { await m.actions.pmCommand('runSim'); for (let i = 0; i < 200 && !m.state.editing.result; i++) await sleep(150); return m.state.editing.result; }; const e = m.state.editing; const kinds = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-pm-set="loadKind"]')].map((b) => b.dataset.value); const fk = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-pm-set="fem.fixtureKind"]')].map((b) => b.dataset.value); m.actions.pmSet('loadKind', 'bearing'); await sleep(100); const note = Boolean(document.querySelector('.left-pm-body .pm-note')); e.fixtures = [mk(at('x', 80), 'fixed')]; e.loads = [mk(hole)]; e.magnitude = 5000; e.dir = '-x'; e.elementSize = 3; const r = await run(); return JSON.stringify({ kinds: ['bearing','remote','mass','centrifugal','thermal'].every((k) => kinds.includes(k)), fk: ['hinge','cylindrical','displacement','cyclic'].every((k) => fk.includes(k)), note, ok: r?.ok, moved: r?.maxDisplacement > 0 }); })()

name: fem loads: a remote load 100 mm past the end bends the plate more than the same force on the end face
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const faces = m.state.partEntry.faces; const all = faces.map((f, index) => ({ f, index })); const mk = (x, kind) => ({ index: x.index, faceId: x.f.hashCode, type: x.f.geomType, ...(kind ? { kind } : {}) }); const planes = all.filter((x) => x.f.geomType === 'PLANE'); const hole = all.find((x) => /CYL/.test(x.f.geomType)); const at = (c, v) => planes.find((x) => Math.abs(x.f.center[c] - v) < 1e-6); const run = async () => { await m.actions.pmCommand('runSim'); for (let i = 0; i < 200 && !m.state.editing.result; i++) await sleep(150); return m.state.editing.result; }; const e = m.state.editing; e.fixtures = [mk(at('x', 0), 'fixed')]; e.loads = [mk(at('x', 80))]; e.magnitude = 200; e.dir = '-z'; e.loadKind = 'force'; e.result = null; const direct = await run(); const d1 = direct.maxDisplacement; e.result = null; m.actions.pmSet('loadKind', 'remote'); m.actions.pmFieldChanged('fem.loadPoint.0', '180'); m.actions.pmFieldChanged('fem.loadPoint.1', '20'); m.actions.pmFieldChanged('fem.loadPoint.2', '5'); await sleep(100); const fields = document.querySelectorAll('[data-pm-field^="fem.loadMoment."]').length; e.result = null; const remote = await run(); return JSON.stringify({ fields, ok: remote?.ok, ratio: remote.maxDisplacement / d1 > 2 }); })()

name: fem loads: a hinge on the hole (rollers keep the plate from turning about it) under a 6000 rpm spin about the hole
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const faces = m.state.partEntry.faces; const all = faces.map((f, index) => ({ f, index })); const mk = (x, kind) => ({ index: x.index, faceId: x.f.hashCode, type: x.f.geomType, ...(kind ? { kind } : {}) }); const planes = all.filter((x) => x.f.geomType === 'PLANE'); const hole = all.find((x) => /CYL/.test(x.f.geomType)); const at = (c, v) => planes.find((x) => Math.abs(x.f.center[c] - v) < 1e-6); const run = async () => { await m.actions.pmCommand('runSim'); for (let i = 0; i < 200 && !m.state.editing.result; i++) await sleep(150); return m.state.editing.result; }; const e = m.state.editing; e.loadKind = 'centrifugal'; e.dir = 'z'; m.actions.pmFieldChanged('fem.loadPoint.0', '20'); m.actions.pmFieldChanged('fem.loadPoint.1', '20'); m.actions.pmFieldChanged('fem.loadPoint.2', '0'); e.magnitude = 6000; e.fixtures = [mk(hole, 'hinge'), mk(at('z', 0), 'roller'), mk(at('y', 0), 'roller')]; e.loads = []; e.result = null; const r = await run(); return JSON.stringify({ ok: r?.ok, stress: r?.maxStress > 0.1 }); })()

name: fem loads: heated 100 °C between end rollers (free sideways): compressed along x, a little under E·α·ΔT away from the hole (the hole's section gives more)
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const faces = m.state.partEntry.faces; const all = faces.map((f, index) => ({ f, index })); const mk = (x, kind) => ({ index: x.index, faceId: x.f.hashCode, type: x.f.geomType, ...(kind ? { kind } : {}) }); const planes = all.filter((x) => x.f.geomType === 'PLANE'); const hole = all.find((x) => /CYL/.test(x.f.geomType)); const at = (c, v) => planes.find((x) => Math.abs(x.f.center[c] - v) < 1e-6); const run = async () => { await m.actions.pmCommand('runSim'); for (let i = 0; i < 200 && !m.state.editing.result; i++) await sleep(150); return m.state.editing.result; }; const e = m.state.editing; e.loadKind = 'thermal'; e.loads = []; m.actions.pmFieldChanged('magnitude', '100'); e.fixtures = [mk(at('x', 0), 'roller'), mk(at('x', 80), 'roller'), mk(at('y', 0), 'roller'), mk(at('z', 0), 'roller')]; e.result = null; const r = await run(); const { probeStatic } = await import('/src/cad/fem/static.js'); const pr = probeStatic(r, [65, 30, 5]); const want = 200000 * 11.7e-6 * 100; return JSON.stringify({ ok: r?.ok, faceless: !document.querySelector('[data-pm-pick="loads"]'), near: pr.stress[0] < 0 && -pr.stress[0] > 0.85 * want && -pr.stress[0] < want && Math.abs(pr.vonMises + pr.stress[0]) < 0.05 * want, s: Math.round(pr.vonMises), sx: Math.round(pr.stress[0]) }); })()

name: fem loads: cylindrical fixture fields and prescribed displacement; cyclic faces pair in pick order
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const faces = m.state.partEntry.faces; const all = faces.map((f, index) => ({ f, index })); const mk = (x, kind) => ({ index: x.index, faceId: x.f.hashCode, type: x.f.geomType, ...(kind ? { kind } : {}) }); const planes = all.filter((x) => x.f.geomType === 'PLANE'); const hole = all.find((x) => /CYL/.test(x.f.geomType)); const at = (c, v) => planes.find((x) => Math.abs(x.f.center[c] - v) < 1e-6); const run = async () => { await m.actions.pmCommand('runSim'); for (let i = 0; i < 200 && !m.state.editing.result; i++) await sleep(150); return m.state.editing.result; }; const e = m.state.editing; m.actions.pmSet('fem.fixtureKind', 'cylindrical'); await sleep(80); const cyl = document.querySelectorAll('[data-pm-toggle^="fem.cyl."]').length; m.actions.pmToggle('fem.cyl.t', true); m.actions.pmFieldChanged('fem.cyl.r', '0.02'); await sleep(80); e.fixtures = [mk(hole, 'cylindrical'), mk(at('x', 0), 'cyclic'), mk(at('x', 80), 'cyclic'), mk(at('y', 0), 'displacement')]; m.actions.pmSet('fem.fixtureKind', 'displacement'); m.actions.pmToggle('fem.disp.z', false); m.actions.pmFieldChanged('fem.disp.x', '0.1'); await sleep(80); const fx = m.sim2 ? null : null; const recs = window.__mymechanics.state.editing; const out = JSON.stringify(m.state.editing.fixtures.length); await m.actions.cancelEditing({ quiet: true }); return JSON.stringify({ cyl, toggles: recs.cyl.t.on && recs.cyl.r.v === 0.02, disp: recs.disp.z.on === false && recs.disp.x.v === 0.1 }); })()
